title: 第21章 天刹魔女斩杀灵媒大祭司第22章 误会大了洛游我操你妈
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 对于大虞军中的各种机密，剑老掌握的也不多。
这么短的时间，他也仅能探查到对方的姓名。
具体身份，并不得知。
不过，事情牵连到烈虎军。
一旦出事，那必然与镇国王府脱不开关系的。
“洛游？”
“武宁侯洛家？”
听到洛游这两个字，孟尘一下子都明白了。
他早先便从皇姐口中得知，武宁侯有一个儿子，自幼便进入军中，成为了黎清月身边的左膀右臂。
而且，此人对黎清月爱慕有加。
边境趋势灵虚阁出手截杀他的幕后主使，便来自洛家。
眼下，他将要参加秋岚狩猎，秘境外围便有灵媒一族身影出现，意图操控妖兽汇聚。
而灵媒一族想要过来，必然会踏过防线，且至少会有一位大祭司带领。
而镇守在那里的人，正是这个洛游！
若是他与灵媒一族大祭司勾结，想要趁机秋岚狩猎针对自己，那这一切就太说的通了！
至于灵媒一族越界，只要不闹出大动静，操控妖兽之事完成，直接退回去，便不会有任何人知晓事情的究竟。
自然，也就怀疑不到他的头上。
即便，真的生出事端，这件事第一个牵连的，也只能是黎清月。
毕竟，洛游是她手下的人，坐镇在那里的都是烈虎军中的人。
说不定，针对此事，那洛游已经想出了各种对应之策。
若袭杀自己不成，借此事威胁黎清月，也是有可能的。
孟尘虽然刚回来，但对于镇国王府以及黎清月目前的处境，也了解的差不多了。
这个庞大的王府，手握军权，看似荣誉满身，巍峨不倒，实则已经风雨飘摇，被各大势力虎视眈眈了。
否则，也就没有这一纸婚书了。
此事，区区一个武宁侯世子洛游，虽然办不到拿捏黎清月，但他背后若有一位皇子出手，那就另说了。
“看来，危险的不是我，而是她啊……”
孟尘算是明白了。
他与黎清月都是棋子。
不同的是，他这枚棋子心甘情愿入局，可自保。
而黎清月这枚棋子。
被逼的没有选择，想要自保，只得与自己完婚了。
“洛游是武宁侯洛家的人？”
剑老一拍脑袋，暗道自己老糊涂了，竟然没第一时间想到这一层关系。
不过，这也怨不得他。
当日孟瑜和孟尘对话，提及武宁侯有两个儿子，其中一人跟在黎清月身边时，剑老并不在场。
孟尘点头，在母妃宫中观看黎清月画像时，他多问了一些人，其中便有这个武宁侯世子。
content_en:
Jian Lao didn't know much about the various secrets in Dayu's army.
In such a short period of time, he could only find out the other party's name.
The specific identity is not known.
However, the matter involved the Fierce Tiger Army.
Once something goes wrong, it will definitely have something to do with the Zhen Wang Mansion.
"Luo You?"
"Wuninghou Luo family?"
When Meng Chen heard the words "Luo You", he understood it all at once.
He had earlier learned from the imperial sister that Marquis Wu Ning had a son who had joined the army since he was a child and became Li Qingyue's right-hand man.
Moreover, this person has great admiration for Li Qingyue.
The mastermind behind Border Trend Lingxu Pavilion's attempt to intercept and kill him was from the Luo family.
Right now, he was about to participate in Qiulan's hunting, and a group of psychics appeared outside the secret realm, intending to control the gathering of monsters.
If the psychic clan wants to come over, they will definitely step through the defense line, and they will be led by at least one high priest.
And the person guarding there is none other than Luo You!
If he colluded with the high priest of the psychic clan and wanted to take advantage of Qiulan's hunting to target him, then all this would make perfect sense!
As for the psychic mediums who have crossed the line, as long as they don't make a big fuss, complete the control of the monsters, and just go back, no one will know what happened.
Naturally, there is no doubt on his head.
Even if something goes wrong, the first person to be implicated in this matter can only be Li Qingyue.
After all, Luo You is her subordinate, and the people sitting there are all members of the Fierce Tiger Army.
Maybe Naluoyou has come up with various countermeasures to this matter.
If the attack on him fails, it is possible to use this matter to threaten Li Qingyue.
Although Meng Chen had just come back, he already knew a lot about the town's palace and Li Qingyue's current situation.
This huge palace, with military power in its hands, seems to be full of honor and majestic, but in fact it is already in turmoil and is being watched by all the major forces.
Otherwise, there would be no marriage certificate.
Although Luo You, the prince of Wuninghou, could not control Li Qingyue in this matter, if there was a prince behind him, that would be a different story.
"It seems that it is not me who is in danger, but her..."
Meng Chen finally understood.
He and Li Qingyue are both pawns.
The difference is that he is a chess piece who is willing to enter the game and can protect himself.
And Li Qingyue is the chess piece.
She was forced to have no choice but to protect herself, so she had no choice but to marry herself.
"Luo You is from the Luo family of Marquis Wuning?"
Jian Lao slapped his head and secretly thought that he was too confused to think of this relationship at the first time.
However, I can't blame him for this.
Meng Yu had a conversation with Meng Chen that day and mentioned that Marquis Wu Ning had two sons, and when one of them followed Li Qingyue, Jian Lao was not present.
"Yeah."
Meng Chen nodded. When he was looking at the portrait of Li Qingyue in his mother's palace, he asked a few more people, and among them was the Prince Wuninghou.
